Noelle (CSM): Quick sync — final QBR prep for AuroraPay. Need: exec one-liner, onboarding status slide, renewal-risk blurb. Lock by EOD?

Sam (Enablement): I can own onboarding. Current blocker: missing sample mapping for embedded receipts. Will propose mapping workshop + templates.

Ibrahim (Eng): We deployed an ingest patch; backlog catch-up ~48h. Will add a short perf note (p95 ~410ms on dedicated).

Liu (CS Ops): Heatmap status: AuroraPay = amber (embed activation down 22% m/m). Mitigation: enablement + 30d adoption pulse. Owner = Sam.

Priya (Product): Exec one-liner draft: "Remove onboarding blockers to demonstrate embed-led revenue impact." Shorten?

Noelle (CSM): Shorten to: "Remove onboarding blockers to prove embed ROI." Approved.

Sam (Enablement): Workshop plan: 1x60m mapping, 1x90m hands-on, templates + follow-up pulse (7/28 & 8/11). Owner: Sam, due next Wed.

Ibrahim (Eng): Also adding KV cache tuning note that cut tail latency ~15%.

Liu (CS Ops): Canary/fallback note: if ingest lag >6h, route to backup import and ping CSM. Adding runbook link.

qbr-bot: Reminder: use QBR actions tracker — https://docs.internal/qbr-actions

Noelle (CSM): Action rollup for deck notes:
- Sam: Workshop slides + templates (due next Wed)
- Ibrahim: Ingest logs + perf bullets (due EOD)
- Liu: Heatmap + runbook one-liner (due EOD)
- Priya: Exec one-liner confirmed (done)
- Noelle: Final deck + schedule dry run (due tomorrow 10am PT)

Priya (Product): Can we do dry run 10am PT? Execs free at 10:30 if needed.

Noelle (CSM): 10am PT works. Please join: Liu, Sam. Ibrahim first 10 mins for perf.

Sam (Enablement): Will attend and run the workshop ask.

Liu (CS Ops): On it.

Noelle (CSM): After QBR, add feedback items to tracker and tag #aurorapay. Ill post final deck after dry run. Thanks team :sparkles:
